results.test: Real Supabase login creates private profiles for three independent users

Replay is harmless and quota denial leaves transactions and usage unchanged
Concurrent real edge requests cannot exceed the free upload limit
Authenticated users cannot read other accounts or bypass server-owned import writes
Browser profile writes cannot grant Premium, replace billing identity or reset quota
Correction RPCs enforce ownership, stale-edit protection and immutable source values
Later overlapping imports preserve corrected subscriptions and repeated-purchase counts
Malformed input produces a useful error and consumes no quota
The real database resets monthly quota at a new month
Goals persist with positive targets and account isolation
All six actual email templates render with Casher branding
The signed email hook rejects missing fields and queues the correct branded message
Ordinary accounts cannot invoke the privileged email dispatcher
Unsubscribe tokens enforce recipient-scoped preferences and the actual dispatcher suppresses app mail before delivery
Both deployed checkout URLs share one authenticated Stripe session
Hosted Stripe Checkout completed using a test card
Original Stripe-signed CLI delivery activates Pro before any replay injection
The deployed webhook verifies real Stripe events and persists one owner-scoped entitlement
A real Stripe test-clock renewal preserves Pro and advances the period
Failed renewal revokes paid access and routes the existing customer to billing
Payment recovery restores Pro and an old failed event cannot revoke current access
Concurrent reconciliation returns a retryable webhook failure and retry repairs the entitlement
Scheduled reconciliation repairs a genuinely missed sandbox webhook and deleted customers lose paid access
The hosted billing portal schedules cancellation
Deployed billing refresh, portal, cancellation and old-event replay agree with PostgreSQL

Recovery email, one-use link and password replacement work through real local Auth
